description: List your workspace's products with the category confirmed or suggested for each, the category tree, and per category how many outcomes your own products in it have toward the 30 an estimate needs (an inferred outcome counts half). A suggestion comes from the product's name and is not stored until confirmed with set_product_category. Only your workspace's own data is read or shown. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_product_categories
